excluded_as_validation: Building footprints, night lights and grid maps: proxies, not metered consumption.
Household survey-only datasets and solar-home-system records: not site-level mini-grid ground truth.
Synthetic Africa mini-grid datasets: useful for software testing, not real-site validation.
Published archetypal or average daily profiles: not dated first-three-year site outcomes.
